neighbours.label: the word-initial pieces ' cond' / ' contr' when a word splits right after them (condiments, condenses, condensation)
fire: The shop sells spicy condiments and pickles from Korea.
This summary condenses three long books into a single page.
Water vapor forms condensation on the cold window glass.
The waiter brought a tray of condiments with the noodles.
Warm air from the kitchen condenses on the steel pipes.
Jets leave long contrails across the clear winter sky.
Each table has its own set of condiments and napkins.
In humid weather, condensation drips from the ceiling of the shed.
